title: Your Old Phone Could Become a Walking Robot! 🤖
body: Your Old Phone Could Become a Walking Robot! 🤖

Researchers at the University of California turned an old Android phone into the brain of a small robot that walks on two legs, follows people and gets back up after falling — for a hardware cost of only about $400.
Best of all: they tried it on old phones from 2017 and it worked!
Got an old phone sitting in a drawer? What do you do with it? 📱
